nodes.description: Private owner address set in the constructor to msg.sender; gates privileged behavior in approveAndCall and transferownership.
Public mapping of token balances, mutated without SafeMath in transferFrom and written arbitrarily in approveAndCall.
Public nested mapping of spender allowances; decremented unchecked in transferFrom and overwritten in approve.
Address allowed to bypass sale restrictions in ensure; writable by owner through transferownership.
Mapping that whitelists addresses so they skip sale-condition checks inside ensure; set by approveAndCall.
Per-address counter of transfers performed, incremented in transferFrom and compared against _saleNum in condition.
Minimum transfer value enforced by condition.
Maximum transfer value enforced by condition.
Per-address sale limit used by condition to cap how many transfers an address may make.
Public total supply set in the constructor and never otherwise updated, so approveAndCall can mint without changing it.
Constructor that sets name, symbol, totalSupply and assigns the whole supply to msg.sender, which becomes owner.
Public payable transfer that delegates to transferFrom using msg.sender as the source.
Core transfer routine: consumes allowance, checks ensure, then adjusts balances and _onSaleNum with unchecked arithmetic.
Public payable approval that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without any zero-allowance protection.
Internal gate that bypasses all restrictions when _from/_to is owner or tradeAddress, or when canSale[_from] is true.
Internal view that enforces _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits based on _onSaleNum[_from] and the transfer value.
Owner-only function that arbitrarily assigns balanceOf[spender] and whitelists spender in canSale without updating totalSupply.
Owner-only function that overwrites the privileged tradeAddress that bypasses transfer restrictions.
Caller-controlled address used for allowance checks, owner checks and as the implicit source of transfer.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value executed without SafeMath, allowing underflow of the stored balance.
balanceOf[_to] += _value executed without SafeMath, allowing overflow of the recipient balance.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value executed without SafeMath after only a >= check, allowing arithmetic manipulation.
balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*(10**decimals) performed by the owner without cap or totalSupply update, creating unbacked tokens.
_to recipient argument of transfer.
_value amount argument of transfer.
_from source argument of transferFrom, checked against msg.sender and used for allowance and balance lookups.
_to recipient argument of transferFrom, used as the key of the unchecked balance addition.
_value amount argument of transferFrom, used for allowance and balance arithmetic.
_spender argument of approve whose allowance entry is written.
_value amount argument of approve stored as the new allowance.
_from argument of ensure compared against owner, tradeAddress and canSale.
_to argument of ensure compared against owner to bypass restrictions.
_value argument of ensure forwarded to condition.
_from argument of condition used to read _onSaleNum.
_value argument of condition compared with _minSale and _maxSale.
spender argument of approveAndCall that receives an arbitrary balance and whitelist flag.
addedValue argument of approveAndCall multiplied by 10**decimals to mint an arbitrary balance.
addr argument of transferownership assigned to the privileged tradeAddress.
_name argument of the constructor assigned to the token name.
_symbol argument of the constructor assigned to the token symbol.
_supply argument of the constructor scaled by 10**decimals to define totalSupply and the owner balance.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared with _from and used as the spender key to consume allowance[_from][msg.sender].
msg.sender must equal owner for the arbitrary balance assignment and canSale whitelisting to succeed.
msg.sender must equal owner to overwrite the privileged tradeAddress.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner when writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from source to transferFrom.
transfer delegates execution to transferFrom, inheriting all of its state changes.
transferFrom cannot proceed unless ensure returns true, so the owner/tradeAddress/canSale bypass directly controls transfers.
ensure invokes condition for callers that are not exempt from the sale restrictions.
transferFrom performs balanceOf[_from] -= _value without SafeMath, permitting underflow.
transferFrom performs balanceOf[_to] += _value without SafeMath, permitting overflow.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] with a raw subtraction after only a >= check.
approveAndCall computes addedValue*(10**decimals) and assigns it directly to balanceOf without cap or supply update.
transferownership writes tradeAddress, a privileged address that bypasses ensure checks.
canSale[_from] being true causes ensure to skip all transfer restrictions.
tradeAddress is compared against _from and _to, granting a restriction bypass in ensure.
_onSaleNum[_from] is read by condition to decide whether the sale count limit is exceeded.
_minSale is read by condition to reject values below the minimum sale amount.
_maxSale is read by condition to reject values above the maximum sale amount.
The caller-supplied _value flows directly into the unchecked subtraction of balanceOf[_from].
The caller-supplied _to address is used as the key of the unchecked balance addition.
addedValue is multiplied by 10**decimals and written straight into balanceOf[spender].
_supply scaled by 10**decimals defines totalSupply and the constructor's owner balance.

normalization_plan.reason: The _to recipient parameter of transfer only exists to feed the delegated transferFrom call.
The _value parameter of transfer is only passed through to transferFrom.
The _from parameter is a transient argument of transferFrom used for allowance and balance lookups.
The _to parameter is only consumed as the index of the unchecked recipient balance addition.
The _value parameter is only consumed by the unchecked source balance subtraction.
The _spender parameter is only used to index the allowance mapping written by approve.
The _value parameter of approve is only stored as the new allowance value.
The _from parameter of ensure is a transient argument compared against the privileged addresses and canSale.
The _to parameter of ensure is a transient argument used only for the owner bypass comparison.
The _value parameter of ensure is forwarded to condition and carries no persistent state.
The _from parameter of condition is only used to read _onSaleNum.
The _value parameter of condition is only compared against the min and max sale bounds.
The spender parameter is only used as the balance key in the unchecked mint assignment.
addedValue is only used in the unbacked balance computation for the spender.
The addr parameter is only used to overwrite the privileged tradeAddress.
The _name parameter is only assigned to the name state variable in the constructor.
The _symbol parameter is only assigned to the symbol state variable in the constructor.
The _supply parameter is only used to initialize totalSupply and the owner balance.
